subject: english
title: 過去進行形 (was / were + -ing)
description: 「（そのとき）〜していた」を表す過去進行形。肯定文・否定文・疑問文と when 節との組み合わせ。

story.text: I was reading a book in my room at nine last night.
story.note: 【肯定文】主語が I / he / she / it なら was ＋ 動詞の -ing 形。「昨夜9時に部屋で本を読んでいました」。

story.text: My parents were watching TV in the living room.
story.note: 【複数の主語】you / we / they や複数名詞なら were を使います。

story.text: My brother wasn't studying. He was playing a video game.
story.note: 【否定文】was / were の後に not。wasn't = was not、weren't = were not。

story.text: Were you sleeping when I called you? No, I wasn't.
story.note: 【疑問文】Was / Were を主語の前に出します。答えも was / were を使います。

story.text: What were you doing at that time? I was taking a bath.
story.note: 【疑問詞】What were you doing? で「何をしていたの？」。答えは過去進行形で。

story.text: When I got to the station, it was raining hard.
story.note: 【when 節】「〜したとき（短い出来事）」に「〜していた（続いている動作）」を組み合わせます。

flashcards.desc: was / were ＋ 動詞の -ing 形

flashcards.term: was と were の使い分け
flashcards.desc: I・3人称単数 → was ／ you・複数 → were
was / were の後に not（wasn't / weren't）

flashcards.hint: 答えは Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.

flashcards.desc: make → making（e をとる）、run → running（子音字を重ねる）
know, like, want など状態を表す動詞はふつう進行形にしない

scrambles.question: 「私はそのとき昼食を作っていました。」
「あなたたちは公園で何をしていたのですか。」
「ケンが来たとき、私たちは歌を歌っていました。」

cloze.question: Tom and I [___] playing tennis at three yesterday.
cloze.explanation: 主語 Tom and I は複数なので were。yesterday があるので過去形です。

cloze.question: She was [___] a letter when the phone rang.
cloze.explanation: was の後は -ing 形。write は e をとって writing。

cloze.question: "Was Mike studying then?" "No, he [___]."
cloze.explanation: Was で聞かれたら was / wasn't で答えます。

quizzes.q: 「私が帰宅したとき、妹は眠っていました。」に合う英文はどれか？
options: My sister was sleeping when I came home.
My sister is sleeping when I came home.
My sister slept when I was coming home.
My sister was sleep when I came home.
quizzes.explanation: 続いていた動作（眠っていた）は過去進行形、短い出来事（帰宅した）は過去形です。

quizzes.q: What were they doing at seven? に対する答えとして正しいものはどれか？
quizzes.explanation: 疑問詞の疑問文には Yes / No で答えません。過去進行形で具体的に答えます。

quizzes.q: 誤りを含む文はどれか？
quizzes.explanation: know は状態を表す動詞なので進行形にしません。I knew the answer. が正しい形です。

quizzes.q: run の -ing 形として正しいものはどれか？
quizzes.explanation: 「短母音＋子音字」で終わる語は子音字を重ねて -ing：run → running, swim → swimming, sit → sitting。
